ValidationRule.description: The field 'Follow-up Department' is required when if Pending Reason = Internal Response. The epic for reference #1008. The rule updated for CAC Executive Escalations record type. For ref, check user story #27296 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(RecordType_Name__c ="Global Service Case",RecordType_Name__c ="CAC Executive Escalations"), ISPICKVAL( NAS_Pending_Reason__c , "Internal Response" ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Follow_up_Department__c ,"" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Follow-up Department' is required when if Pending Reason = Internal Response.
